title: How Euclid discovered comet C/2026 S1

segments.en: A telescope built to map the dark Universe just discovered a comet. Here is how.
segments.en_cap: A telescope built to map|the dark Universe|just discovered a comet.|Here is how.

segments.en: Euclid holds the distant stars steady. But a nearby object keeps moving.
segments.en_cap: Euclid holds the distant|stars steady.|But a nearby object|keeps moving.

segments.en: Over a long exposure, that motion paints a short streak of light.
segments.en_cap: Over a long exposure,|that motion paints|a short streak of light.

segments.en: Search software flagged the stretched shape, hiding among countless distant points of light.
segments.en_cap: Search software flagged|the stretched shape,|hiding among countless|distant points of light.

segments.en: The team predicted where the same object should appear in other images.
segments.en_cap: The team predicted where|the same object should|appear in other images.

segments.en: They found it in sixteen exposures, across five different fields of view.
segments.en_cap: They found it in|16 exposures, across|5 different fields|of view.

segments.en: A fuzzy cloud around the object revealed dust and gas: the signature of an active comet.
segments.en_cap: A fuzzy cloud around|the object revealed|dust and gas:|the signature of|an active comet.

segments.en: It matched no known comet or asteroid. Ground-based follow-up helped confirm a new comet.
segments.en_cap: It matched no known|comet or asteroid.|Ground-based follow-up|helped confirm|a new comet.

segments.en: Meet C twenty twenty-six S one, Euclid.
Hidden in plain sight, until its motion gave it away.
